name: Aroha Renata
bio:
Aroha's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with her father's farm machinery. That practical background led her to an apprenticeship at a local engineering firm, where she quickly developed a knack for precision fabrication. A chance encounter with a race team owner at a local speedway event sparked her interest in joining the racing world. She has a 'no-nonsense' approach to her work, demanding perfection in every weld and component. 

Renata joined Signature Racing five years ago after a successful stint with a smaller touring car team. Her focus on quality and durability has significantly improved the team's reliability record. While she prefers working independently, she understands the importance of collaboration and is always willing to share her knowledge with younger members of the team. Her quiet intensity and unwavering commitment to excellence make her a valuable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often pulled back with a headband.
physical.description: Aroha has a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an absurdly fine point.
Insists on using a specific brand of welding rods, claiming they produce a superior weld.
Listens to classic Māori waiata while working, but only at a low volume.
